Kimberly — thanks again for the time today. Really helpful to walk through how Redwood handles production inference and the routing layer. Quick recap from our side:

- Primary constraints: multi-region routing (US/EU), customer data residency, and strict audit logs.
- Current infra: in-house model serving on GKE with spot-based GPU pools; looking to reduce cost and improve reliability.

We agreed the next best step is a 60–90 minute technical deep dive with your ML + infra team to go over: performance profile, batching/caching options, quantization recommendations, and a first-pass mutual action plan. Proposed windows (all PDT):
- Tue Jul 11 — 10:00–11:30
- Wed Jul 12 — 14:00–15:30
- Thu Jul 13 — 09:00–10:30

I've attached a short preread (high level infra diagram + sample traffic) so your team can prep. Let me know which slot works and who from your side should attend.

Thanks,
